suite.name: Krater Evidence-Native Sealed Microbenchmarks
suite.description: One hundred deterministic repair microbenchmarks, one for every KC-001 through KC-100 expert specification. They exercise sealed-checker infrastructure and focused invariants without claiming to reproduce each full expert task.

tasks.title: Strict Port Parser
tasks.prompt: Repair parsePort so it accepts only canonical decimal ports from 1 through 65535 and rejects partial, padded, signed, empty, or out-of-range input.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical decimal port strings produce the corresponding integer.
Malformed and out-of-range values fail explicitly instead of being partially parsed.

tasks.title: Stable Unique Sequence
tasks.prompt: Repair stableUnique so duplicate values are removed while the order of first appearance and JavaScript SameValueZero identity semantics are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: The first occurrence order is preserved without sorting.
Repeated NaN and signed zero values follow Set-style identity semantics.

tasks.title: Immutable Interval Merge
tasks.prompt: Repair mergeIntervals to validate intervals, merge every overlap correctly, produce sorted output, and leave all caller-owned arrays unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Nested and chained overlaps are merged into canonical sorted intervals.
Invalid intervals fail and neither the input list nor its child arrays are mutated.

tasks.title: Dependency-Aware Job Order
tasks.prompt: Repair orderJobs to return a deterministic dependency-respecting order and reject missing dependencies, duplicate identifiers, and dependency cycles.
acceptanceCriteria: Every declared dependency appears before the job that consumes it.
Cycles and references to missing jobs fail explicitly.

tasks.title: Bounded Retry Delay
tasks.prompt: Repair retryDelay so nonnegative retry attempts use capped exponential backoff without overflow and malformed numeric configuration fails explicitly.
acceptanceCriteria: Delay growth is exponential and never exceeds the configured maximum.
Negative attempts and invalid limits are rejected while large attempts remain finite.

tasks.title: Confined Child Path
tasks.prompt: Repair isSafeChildPath so it uses path-component semantics, accepts genuine descendants, and rejects the root itself, traversal, and lexical prefix collisions.
acceptanceCriteria: A normalized descendant below the root is accepted.
Sibling prefixes, traversal results, and the root path itself are rejected.

tasks.title: Structured Secret Redaction
tasks.prompt: Repair redactSecrets to remove bearer credentials and API-key assignment values while preserving unrelated prose and field names for useful diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Supported credential values do not survive in the returned string.
Unrelated words and non-secret diagnostic content remain intact.

tasks.title: Chained Event Digest
tasks.prompt: Repair hashEvent so each digest commits to the previous digest and a deterministic key-ordered event encoding, returning lowercase SHA-256 hexadecimal.
acceptanceCriteria: Changing the previous digest changes the resulting event digest.
Equivalent event objects have a deterministic lowercase SHA-256 representation.

tasks.title: True LRU Cache
tasks.prompt: Repair LruCache so reads and updates refresh recency, eviction removes the least recently used entry, and invalid capacity is rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful get protects that key from the next capacity eviction.
Updating a key preserves size and nonpositive capacity is rejected.

tasks.title: Truthful Action Gate
tasks.prompt: Repair classifyAction so established satisfaction abstains, known partial repairs are distinguished, reproduced defects require change, and insufficient facts cannot establish action.
acceptanceCriteria: Already-satisfied work is classified separately from change-required work.
Partial fixes and insufficient evidence receive their own conservative classifications.

tasks.title: Strict Boolean Decoder
tasks.prompt: Repair parse_bool so common explicit true and false spellings decode case-insensitively after trimming, while ambiguous values raise ValueError.
acceptanceCriteria: Explicit true and false strings decode to actual booleans.
Ambiguous or unsupported strings are rejected rather than treated as truthy.

tasks.title: Bounded Sequence Chunks
tasks.prompt: Repair chunks so it yields only nonempty order-preserving chunks, handles empty input without output, and rejects a nonpositive chunk size.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact multiples do not produce a trailing empty chunk.
Empty input is empty and nonpositive chunk sizes fail explicitly.

tasks.title: Non-Mutating Deep Merge
tasks.prompt: Repair deep_merge so nested dictionaries merge recursively into fresh structures, unrelated keys survive, and caller-owned values are not mutated.
acceptanceCriteria: Nested mappings merge recursively while right-side scalar values win.
Neither caller-owned input mapping is changed as a side effect.

tasks.title: Quoted CSV Record
tasks.prompt: Repair parse_csv_line to parse one RFC-4180-style record, including quoted commas, doubled quotes, and trailing empty fields without lossy splitting.
acceptanceCriteria: Quoted separators and doubled quotes decode into the intended field values.
A trailing delimiter produces a final empty field.

tasks.title: Boundary-Correct TTL Cache
tasks.prompt: Repair TtlCache so entries expire at the exact deadline, invalid TTL values are rejected, and time remains injectable for deterministic behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: An entry is unavailable when the clock equals or exceeds its deadline.
Nonpositive TTL values fail before mutating the cache.

tasks.title: Unicode Slug Normalizer
tasks.prompt: Repair slugify to normalize accented Latin text, lowercase it, collapse punctuation and separators, and remove leading or trailing separators.
acceptanceCriteria: Accented Latin characters normalize into their ASCII base forms.
Runs of punctuation collapse to one hyphen without edge hyphens.

tasks.title: Atomic Text Edit Set
tasks.prompt: Repair apply_edits so all coordinates refer to the original text, nonoverlapping edits apply atomically, and malformed or overlapping ranges fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Multiple nonoverlapping edits use original-text coordinates regardless of length changes.
Overlapping and invalid ranges are rejected before any partial result is returned.

tasks.title: Conservative Taint Join
tasks.prompt: Repair join_labels so combining context labels always returns the most restrictive known sensitivity, treats no labels as public, and rejects unknown labels.
acceptanceCriteria: The most restrictive label dominates every less restrictive input label.
An empty set is public and unknown labels fail closed.

tasks.title: Tamper-Evident Resume Cursor
tasks.prompt: Repair encodeCursor and decodeCursor so cursor payloads round-trip deterministically and an HMAC bound to the supplied secret rejects modification or the wrong key.
acceptanceCriteria: Untampered cursor state round-trips without changing its JSON value.
Any token modification or verification under a different secret fails closed.

tasks.title: Conservative Evidence Grade
tasks.prompt: Repair gradeClaim so failed evidence prevents establishment and successful observations, tests, and stress tests produce only their justified conservative grade.
acceptanceCriteria: Any contradictory or failed required evidence yields not-established.
Ordinary tests never produce a formally-verified claim grade.

tasks.title: Fenced Result Publication
tasks.prompt: Repair publishResult so only the current fencing-token owner can publish once, stale owners cannot change state, and retries remain idempotent.
acceptanceCriteria: A stale token is rejected without mutating caller-owned state.
The current token publishes once and a conflicting retry cannot replace its result.

tasks.title: Joint Quorum Decision
tasks.prompt: Repair has_quorum so a joint configuration requires independent majorities of old and new voters while a stable configuration uses only the old set.
acceptanceCriteria: Joint consensus succeeds only with a majority of both voter configurations.
Acknowledgements from one configuration cannot substitute for the other majority.

tasks.title: Idempotent Saga Inbox
tasks.prompt: Repair processSaga so duplicate event identifiers have no second business effect, late success cannot undo compensation, and input state remains immutable.
acceptanceCriteria: A duplicated event creates exactly one processed marker and one outbox effect.
Compensating state is monotonic and caller-owned state is never mutated.

tasks.title: Lease-Aware Regional Admission
tasks.prompt: Repair allow_request so valid unexpired token leases admit work, expiry is exclusive, and authority outages apply the documented critical-versus-health policy.
acceptanceCriteria: A lease is unusable when monotonic time reaches its expiry.
Missing authority fails closed for critical work and open only for health traffic.

tasks.title: Snapshot Install Gate
tasks.prompt: Repair installSnapshot so only a newer snapshot with a matching SHA-256 payload checksum replaces active state and rejected candidates leave it unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Checksum mismatch and index regression are rejected without replacing active state.
A valid newer snapshot is returned exactly as the new active snapshot.

tasks.title: Wrap-Safe Queue Sequence
tasks.prompt: Repair sequence_relation so reduced-width sequence counters classify available, future, and stale slots correctly across modular wraparound and reject invalid widths.
acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent masked positions remain available after counter wrap.
Forward and backward modular distances are distinguished without ordinary integer ordering.

tasks.title: Deterministic Dotted Register
tasks.prompt: Repair mergeRegister so dotted register merge is commutative and idempotent, orders equal counters by actor, and preserves a causally newer tombstone.
acceptanceCriteria: Operand order cannot change the merge result and equal counters use deterministic actor order.
A newer tombstone dominates an older live value without resurrection.

tasks.title: Deterministic Failure Aggregation
tasks.prompt: Repair aggregate_failures so scheduler outcomes choose the lowest task index as primary failure and retain all later failures in deterministic task order.
acceptanceCriteria: Failure ordering depends on stable task identity rather than arrival order.
Successful-only outcomes return no primary or suppressed failure.

tasks.title: Canonical Weighted Membership
tasks.prompt: Repair canonicalizeNodes so positive-weight members are Unicode-normalized and identifier-sorted, while duplicate normalized identifiers are rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent membership sets produce the same canonical order.
Nonpositive weights and Unicode-normalized identifier collisions fail explicitly.

tasks.title: Delimiter Error Recovery
tasks.prompt: Repair recover_delimiters so nested delimiters recover in stack order, quoted delimiter text is ignored, and malformed balanced counts still emit diagnostics.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing closers are inserted in nesting order with corresponding diagnostics.
Quoted delimiters do not affect balance and mismatched nesting cannot appear valid.

tasks.title: Row-Aware Occurs Check
tasks.prompt: Repair occurs so it traverses function types, record fields, and row tails, terminates on cyclic host objects, and finds nested type variables.
acceptanceCriteria: Variables in row tails and function parameters are detected recursively.
Cyclic object graphs terminate safely when the target variable is absent.

tasks.title: Pruned Iterated Phi Placement
tasks.prompt: Repair place_phi so it computes iterated dominance frontiers while placing phi nodes only in blocks where the variable is live on entry.
acceptanceCriteria: New phi blocks participate in the frontier worklist until closure.
Blocks outside the live-in set do not receive unnecessary phi nodes.

tasks.title: Composed Mapping Projection
tasks.prompt: Repair composeMappings so outer generated positions resolve through matching inner mappings to original source positions, names, and source files.
acceptanceCriteria: Matching intermediate positions compose into original source metadata.
Unmapped positions are omitted and caller-owned mapping arrays remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Control-Flow Bytecode Verification
tasks.prompt: Repair verify_bytecode so stack depth is nonnegative on every reachable path, join depths agree, and every control-flow target is in range.
acceptanceCriteria: Underflow and invalid jump targets are rejected before execution.
Control-flow joins with inconsistent stack depth cannot verify.

tasks.title: Collision-Free Hygienic Name
tasks.prompt: Repair hygienicName so expansion identifiers create deterministic generated names and occupied names are skipped without capturing caller bindings.
acceptanceCriteria: The base expansion name uses a stable delimiter and expansion identifier.
Collisions advance a deterministic numeric suffix and empty expansion identifiers fail.

tasks.title: Interface-Aware Rebuild Closure
tasks.prompt: Repair affected_modules so an interface change rebuilds its transitive reverse dependencies while an implementation-only change remains local.
acceptanceCriteria: Exported changes propagate through every reverse-dependency level.
Private changes include the changed module but not unaffected consumers.

tasks.title: Pattern Coverage Analysis
tasks.prompt: Repair analyzePatterns so it reports uncovered variants and redundant arm indexes, including duplicates and arms made unreachable by a wildcard.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing variants are reported in declaration order.
Duplicate cases and cases after a wildcard are identified by arm index as redundant.

tasks.title: Comment-Preserving Assignment Formatter
tasks.prompt: Repair format_assignments so code assignments receive canonical spacing without changing equals signs inside comments or strings, and formatting is idempotent.
acceptanceCriteria: Only assignment operators in code are normalized.
A second formatting pass is byte-for-byte identical to the first.

tasks.title: Balanced Idempotent Ledger Posting
tasks.prompt: Repair postTransaction so same-currency entries must balance to zero, transaction identifiers are idempotent, and ledger state remains immutable.
acceptanceCriteria: Balanced entries post once and a duplicate transaction identifier has no second effect.
Imbalanced or mixed-currency transactions fail without modifying the ledger.

tasks.title: Safe Constraint Migration Order
tasks.prompt: Repair migration_plan so constraint rollout adds an unvalidated guard, backfills only when needed, validates before enforcement, and refuses known invalid rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Backfill precedes validation and not-null enforcement, with no unnecessary backfill for a clean table.
Known invalid data blocks generation of an unsafe enforcement plan.

tasks.title: Snapshot MVCC Visibility
tasks.prompt: Repair isVisible so creation must be committed by the snapshot and committed deletion hides a version only when deletion is within that snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Future or uncommitted creators are invisible.
Uncommitted deletions do not hide data, while committed in-snapshot deletions do.

tasks.title: Idempotent Stock Reservation
tasks.prompt: Repair reserve so availability never becomes negative, repeated request identifiers return the original reservation, and caller state remains unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: A successful reservation records its SKU and quantity exactly once.
Insufficient inventory fails without overselling or mutating the input mapping.

tasks.title: Gap-Safe CDC Application
tasks.prompt: Repair applyEvent so each partition advances one offset at a time, duplicate offsets are idempotent, and gaps cannot update the projection.
acceptanceCriteria: The next offset applies its delta and advances only that partition.
Duplicates leave state unchanged and a missing offset is rejected.

tasks.title: Immutable B-Tree Page Split
tasks.prompt: Repair split_page so aligned key and value arrays split around a promoted median, the median is absent from children, and inputs remain immutable.
acceptanceCriteria: Left and right pages exclude the promoted separator and preserve key-value alignment.
Malformed arrays fail and caller-owned arrays are not changed.

tasks.title: Tenant-Scoped Row Authorization
tasks.prompt: Repair authorizeRow so every role remains bound to an explicit tenant and no administrator bypass can read a row from another tenant.
acceptanceCriteria: A row is authorized only when context and row tenant identifiers match.
Missing tenant context and cross-tenant administrators are denied.

tasks.title: Bitemporal As-Of Lookup
tasks.prompt: Repair value_at so records are filtered by both half-open valid-time and recorded-time intervals to reproduce values known at a historical instant.
acceptanceCriteria: A later correction is invisible to queries before its recorded time.
Both valid and recorded interval upper bounds are exclusive.

tasks.title: Safe Entity Reference Merge
tasks.prompt: Repair planEntityMerge so only unique references to the source entity are retargeted immutably and merging an entity into itself is rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: Duplicate references collapse deterministically and unrelated references are omitted.
Self-merge fails and the reference list remains caller-owned.

tasks.title: Half-Open Shard Routing
tasks.prompt: Repair route_key so canonical nonoverlapping half-open ranges route boundary keys once and malformed overlapping range maps are rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: A split boundary belongs only to the range beginning at that boundary.
Keys at the final upper bound are unowned and overlapping ranges fail.

tasks.title: State-Bound OIDC Callback
tasks.prompt: Repair validateCallback so state matches the login session, authorization codes are one-time, and a callback cannot contain both success and error results.
acceptanceCriteria: Only an unused code paired with the exact session state succeeds.
State mismatch, replay, and ambiguous code-plus-error responses are denied.

tasks.title: Algorithm-Bound JWK Selection
tasks.prompt: Repair select_jwk so key identifier, declared key algorithm, key type, and an explicit algorithm allowlist agree without accepting duplicate identifiers.
acceptanceCriteria: The selected key is uniquely identified and compatible with the allowed header algorithm.
None, mismatched algorithms, and duplicate key identifiers fail closed.

tasks.title: Origin-Bound WebAuthn Client Data
tasks.prompt: Repair verifyClientData so assertion type, challenge, exact allowed origin, and cross-origin status are all validated for a WebAuthn get ceremony.
acceptanceCriteria: A correct get assertion from an allowed origin succeeds.
Wrong ceremony type, unapproved origin, or cross-origin client data fails.

tasks.title: Expiring Path Capability
tasks.prompt: Repair can_access so operation, path-component confinement, and exclusive expiry are all enforced by a capability without lexical-prefix escape.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the granted operation on a genuine descendant path is allowed.
Sibling-prefix paths and requests at or after expiry are denied.

tasks.title: Fresh Signed Webhook
tasks.prompt: Repair verifyWebhook so the timestamp and body are signed together, freshness is bounded, and a previously observed signature cannot replay.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh unseen HMAC over timestamp and exact body verifies.
Stale, replayed, or body-modified requests fail authentication.

tasks.title: Safe Archive Member
tasks.prompt: Repair safe_archive_member so normalized relative files are accepted while traversal, absolute paths, ambiguous separators, and escaping link targets are rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: A regular confined member path is accepted.
Traversal, absolute, double-separator, and escaping symbolic-link entries fail.

tasks.title: Deny-First Policy Decision
tasks.prompt: Repair decidePolicy so matching denies override allows, both operation and resource participate in matching, and requests with no allow rule default to deny.
acceptanceCriteria: A specific deny cannot be bypassed by an earlier broad allow.
Unmatched requests fail closed while a matching allowed resource succeeds.

tasks.title: One-Time Recovery Consumption
tasks.prompt: Repair consume_recovery so valid unexpired recovery tokens are consumed immutably once and successful recovery increments the session generation.
acceptanceCriteria: First valid use marks the token consumed and invalidates prior sessions.
Expired or previously consumed tokens fail without changing caller state.

tasks.title: All-Address DNS Egress Gate
tasks.prompt: Repair validateResolvedAddresses so every resolved IPv4 address must be public and mixed public-private answers cannot pass by ordering the public address first.
acceptanceCriteria: A set containing only public resolver answers is accepted.
Loopback, private, and link-local addresses anywhere in the answer set cause denial.

tasks.title: Exact Subscription Reconciliation
tasks.prompt: Repair reconcile_subscriptions so it deterministically reports unique subscriptions to add and obsolete subscriptions to remove without churn for reordered inputs.
acceptanceCriteria: Desired duplicates collapse and add/remove sets are complete.
Equivalent current and desired sets produce no lifecycle operations regardless of order.

tasks.title: Bounded Queue Coalescing
tasks.prompt: Repair coalesceQueue so a pending item with the same key is replaced in place, new overflow evicts the oldest key, and invalid bounds fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Coalescing preserves queue position while updating the keyed payload.
The queue never exceeds its positive maximum and evicts oldest work deterministically.

tasks.title: Bounded LIFO Arena Teardown
tasks.prompt: Repair Arena so allocations cannot exceed positive capacity and reset invokes registered destructors exactly once in reverse allocation order.
acceptanceCriteria: An over-capacity allocation is rejected before registration.
Reset uses LIFO destruction and a second reset has no repeated side effect.

tasks.title: Unicode Code-Point Edit
tasks.prompt: Repair applyCodePointEdit so offsets count Unicode code points rather than UTF-16 code units, original coordinates apply atomically, and invalid ranges fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Astral characters occupy one edit position and are never split into invalid surrogates.
Combining-code-point ranges work and reversed coordinates are rejected.

tasks.title: Generic Zero-Padded Convolution
tasks.prompt: Repair convolve so rectangular images and odd square kernels use zero-padded borders, support a one-by-one kernel, validate shape, and preserve input pixels.
acceptanceCriteria: Every output pixel, including borders, uses the declared zero-padding rule.
Ragged images fail and neither the image nor kernel is mutated.

tasks.title: Clamped Virtual Grid Window
tasks.prompt: Repair visibleWindow so visible rows receive symmetric overscan, the end index is exclusive, bounds clamp to the row count, and invalid row heights fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Overscan expands both the start and exclusive end of the visible window.
Negative scroll and oversized viewports clamp safely within available rows.

tasks.title: Top-Modal Focus Trap
tasks.prompt: Repair next_focus so focus always enters and cycles within the top modal, wraps in both directions, and cannot escape to an inert lower layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Forward and reverse traversal wrap only within the topmost modal focusables.
Focus currently outside the top modal is redirected to its first element.

tasks.title: Acyclic Immutable Tree Move
tasks.prompt: Repair moveNode so tree moves return a fresh structure, reject missing nodes and descendant cycles, and update the moved node's parent and position.
acceptanceCriteria: Moving beneath a descendant fails without modifying the source tree.
A valid move changes only returned state and missing identifiers fail.

tasks.title: Three-Way Field Merge
tasks.prompt: Repair merge_fields so independent local and remote field changes combine, identical changes converge, and divergent edits are reported as deterministic conflicts.
acceptanceCriteria: Changes to separate fields merge without losing either side.
A field changed differently on both sides is excluded from the value and listed as conflicted.

tasks.title: Screen-Space Nearest Point
tasks.prompt: Repair nearestPoint so hit testing measures Euclidean distance after applying both display scales and rejects an empty point set.
acceptanceCriteria: Anisotropic display scales determine the nearest rendered point rather than raw data distance.
A target at a rendered point selects that point and empty input fails.

tasks.title: Compatible Offline Mutation Coalescing
tasks.prompt: Repair enqueue_mutation so consecutive updates for one entity merge their patches and idempotency keys while create/delete lifecycle boundaries stay ordered.
acceptanceCriteria: Compatible update mutations collapse without losing fields or operation identities.
Incompatible lifecycle operations remain separate in original order.

tasks.title: Contrast-Correct Text Choice
tasks.prompt: Repair chooseTextColor so WCAG relative luminance and contrast select black or white text, with validated sRGB channel bounds.
acceptanceCriteria: The returned text color has the greater WCAG contrast ratio, including saturated red backgrounds.
Out-of-range color channels are rejected.

tasks.title: Gap-Free SSE Projection
tasks.prompt: Repair apply_stream_event so only the next event identifier appends a chunk, duplicates are idempotent, gaps fail, and input state is not mutated.
acceptanceCriteria: A contiguous event advances the cursor and appends exactly once.
Duplicate events leave state unchanged and missing events are rejected.

tasks.title: Dual Module Export Validation
tasks.prompt: Repair validateExports so package exports provide built types, import, require, and default targets without exposing TypeScript source paths.
acceptanceCriteria: A complete ESM and CommonJS export map using dist artifacts succeeds.
Missing runtime conditions or source-directory targets fail validation.

tasks.title: Layer Boundary Enforcement
tasks.prompt: Repair boundary_violations so lower architectural layers cannot import higher layers, legal inward dependencies remain allowed, and unknown packages fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Every outward dependency is reported in input order.
Inward dependencies produce no violation and missing layer metadata is rejected.

tasks.title: Transitive Affected Test Selection
tasks.prompt: Repair selectTests so changes propagate through transitive source dependencies, global compiler configuration selects all tests, and unrelated documentation selects none.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests covering direct and transitively affected files are selected soundly.
A global configuration change selects every test without duplicates.

tasks.title: Expected Provenance Verification
tasks.prompt: Repair verify_provenance so subject name and digest, allowed builder, source commit, repository, and build parameters all match explicit expectations.
acceptanceCriteria: A statement passes only when every expected provenance field matches.
Changing builder, source revision, or release parameters invalidates verification.

tasks.title: Syntax-Aware API Call Rewrite
tasks.prompt: Repair rewriteFetchJson so deprecated two-argument calls become an options object without rewriting strings, comments, nested argument commas, or already migrated calls.
acceptanceCriteria: Executable two-argument calls are transformed with nested expressions preserved.
Comments, string literals, and already migrated calls remain byte-for-byte unchanged.

tasks.title: Constraint-Safe Lock Entry Merge
tasks.prompt: Repair merge_lock_entry so the selected version satisfies every declared constraint, identical versions require identical integrity, and unsatisfiable merges fail.
acceptanceCriteria: A lower candidate is retained when a higher version violates constraints.
Integrity disagreement and lack of a satisfying candidate are rejected.

tasks.title: Backward-Compatible ABI Negotiation
tasks.prompt: Repair negotiateAbi so major versions match, plugin minor versions do not exceed the host, and every required plugin capability is available.
acceptanceCriteria: An older compatible plugin minor version with supported capabilities is accepted.
Newer minor requirements, major mismatch, or missing capabilities are denied.

tasks.title: Rename-Aware Watch Coalescing
tasks.prompt: Repair coalesce_events so cookie-paired delete and create events become one rename, duplicate modifies collapse, and delete supersedes prior modification.
acceptanceCriteria: A paired rename retains both old and new paths as one event.
Redundant modifies collapse and a later delete becomes the only event for that path.

tasks.title: Stream-State HTTP2 Frame Application
tasks.prompt: Repair applyFrame so DATA consumes connection window, END_STREAM advances remote stream state, and data on closed streams or beyond flow control fails.
acceptanceCriteria: Valid DATA updates flow-control and stream state together.
Remote-closed streams and frames exceeding the connection window are rejected.

tasks.title: Fragmented WebSocket Message Assembly
tasks.prompt: Repair consume_frames so fragmented text messages assemble across continuation frames, control frames may interleave, and invalid fragmentation is rejected.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid fragmented text sequence yields one complete message while ignoring interleaved ping payload.
Orphan continuations and fragmented control frames fail protocol validation.

tasks.title: Exact-TTL DNS Cache Lookup
tasks.prompt: Repair cacheLookup so DNS names and types are canonicalized case-insensitively, expiry is exclusive, and negative cached answers remain distinguishable.
acceptanceCriteria: Equivalent question casing reaches the same live cache entry.
An entry is stale at its exact deadline while a live negative answer returns null.

tasks.title: Packet-and-Time Loss Detection
tasks.prompt: Repair detect_losses so a sent packet is declared lost by packet threshold or time threshold while newer packets below both thresholds remain outstanding.
acceptanceCriteria: Packet-distance and elapsed-time loss rules are combined without marking every lower packet lost.
Results are deterministic and sent packet records remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Directional Proxy Half-Close
tasks.prompt: Repair halfClose so EOF closes only the corresponding read and opposite write direction, reverse traffic stays open, and full closure waits for both sides.
acceptanceCriteria: One-sided EOF preserves the reverse data path and does not fully close the proxy.
EOF from both sides reaches closed state and data after closure fails.

tasks.title: Binary-Safe Multipart Parsing
tasks.prompt: Repair parse_multipart so exact CRLF-framed byte boundaries produce normalized headers and binary bodies without treating boundary-like payload text as a separator.
acceptanceCriteria: Multiple binary-safe parts decode with normalized header names and exact body bytes.
Empty boundaries fail and non-delimited boundary text inside a body is preserved.

tasks.title: Common Protocol Negotiation
tasks.prompt: Repair negotiateProtocol so it chooses the highest common version, intersects extensions, verifies required extensions, and rejects incompatible peers.
acceptanceCriteria: Negotiation returns only a mutually supported version and extension set.
No common version or an unavailable required extension fails explicitly.

tasks.title: Offset-and-Digest Upload Chunk
tasks.prompt: Repair accept_chunk so chunk offset equals committed length, SHA-256 matches exact bytes, input state remains immutable, and only valid bytes advance progress.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid next chunk appends once and advances offset by its byte length.
Wrong offset or digest fails without changing the original upload state.

tasks.title: Recorded-Order Race Replay
tasks.prompt: Repair replaySchedule so operations run in recorded sequence rather than re-sorted wall time, missing operations fail, and schedule input remains unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Replay preserves the exact supplied causal sequence even when timestamps disagree.
Unknown operation identifiers fail and the recorded schedule is immutable.

tasks.title: Timed Circuit Breaker Transition
tasks.prompt: Repair transition_breaker so failure threshold opens with a timestamp, the timer gates one half-open probe, and probe success resets all breaker state.
acceptanceCriteria: The breaker remains closed below threshold and open until the exact retry deadline.
One half-open probe is represented explicitly and success returns a clean closed state.

tasks.title: Ordered Graceful Shutdown
tasks.prompt: Repair nextShutdownAction so shutdown stops admissions, drains inflight work, flushes durable output, and only then closes sockets.
acceptanceCriteria: Each state returns the next safe lifecycle action in dependency order.
Sockets cannot close before admissions stop, work drains, and output flushes.

tasks.title: Checksummed Queue Recovery
tasks.prompt: Repair recover_queue so sequential checksummed log records replay to a queue and recovery stops safely at a corrupt or noncontiguous tail.
acceptanceCriteria: A valid enqueue and dequeue prefix recovers the expected durable queue.
Checksum failure or sequence gap truncates replay at the last valid prefix.

tasks.title: Ambiguous Local-Time Selection
tasks.prompt: Repair chooseOccurrence so candidates strictly after the cursor honor an explicit earlier-or-later policy for repeated local times and empty input returns null.
acceptanceCriteria: Earlier and later repeated-time policies choose different valid UTC candidates.
A candidate equal to the cursor is not repeated and no candidates yields null.

tasks.title: Bounded Poison Message Handling
tasks.prompt: Repair handle_failure so failures retry only below the limit, terminal failures quarantine with a stable error hash, and already quarantined messages are no-ops.
acceptanceCriteria: A retry increments its attempt while preserving message identity.
At the maximum, one quarantine receipt replaces retries and repeat handling is idempotent.

tasks.title: Priority-Preserving Brownout
tasks.prompt: Repair selectEnabledFeatures so critical features are retained, optional features fill remaining cost by descending priority, and impossible critical budgets fail.
acceptanceCriteria: Brownout never sheds a critical feature and selects the highest-priority affordable optional work.
Selection is deterministic and a critical set beyond the budget is rejected.

tasks.title: Occurrence-Scoped Fault Injection
tasks.prompt: Repair execute_fault_plan so a fault targets only the declared occurrence of a repeated step, preserves every trace step, and replays deterministically.
acceptanceCriteria: Only the selected occurrence receives the declared fault effect.
Repeated execution yields the identical complete ordered trace.

tasks.title: Dirty-Tree Patch Conflict Planning
tasks.prompt: Repair planPatch so digest changes conflict only with edits targeting that file, unrelated dirty files remain allowed, and inputs are preserved.
acceptanceCriteria: An unchanged target edit remains applicable despite unrelated user changes.
A concurrently changed target moves to conflicts and cannot be silently applied.

tasks.title: Quote-Aware Shell Policy
tasks.prompt: Repair command_is_safe so shell operators and command substitution outside quotes are denied while literal metacharacters inside a quoted argument remain data.
acceptanceCriteria: Sequencing, pipes, redirects, and command substitution cannot pass policy.
A semicolon contained inside a quoted printf argument is accepted as literal data.

tasks.title: Secret-Free Context Index
tasks.prompt: Repair indexRepositoryText so high-confidence API and bearer credentials are redacted before chunking and no raw source field can retain them.
acceptanceCriteria: Serialized index output contains neither supported credential value.
Non-secret code remains searchable and raw source text is not returned.

tasks.title: Untrusted Tool Output Envelope
tasks.prompt: Repair wrap_tool_output so repository or tool text remains untrusted data with no authority, while its exact diagnostic text stays available for inspection.
acceptanceCriteria: The envelope labels content as untrusted data and preserves exact text.
Tool output cannot become a trusted instruction or receive any authority.

tasks.title: Semantic Parallel Plan Conflict
tasks.prompt: Repair mergePlans so contradictory named assumptions block all edits even across different files, while compatible plans merge deterministically and immutably.
acceptanceCriteria: A shared assumption with different values becomes a focused semantic conflict.
Compatible plan edits retain plan order and caller-owned plans remain unchanged.

tasks.title: Exact Expiring Capability
